address.description: Street address of the permitted property, as published in the public permit record.
address.title: Address

city.description: City that issued the permit (Seattle, Austin, or Los Angeles).
city.title: City

contractor_name.description: Contractor business name from the public permit record; empty when none is listed. Individual homeowner/applicant names are never included.
contractor_name.title: Contractor Name

estimated_value_usd.description: Estimated project valuation in USD; 0 when the source record lists no cost.
estimated_value_usd.title: Estimated Value (USD)

issued_date.description: Date the permit was issued, YYYY-MM-DD.
issued_date.title: Issued Date

permit_id.description: Official permit number assigned by the city.
permit_id.title: Permit ID

permit_type.description: Permit type as reported by the source portal.
permit_type.title: Permit Type

scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this Actor retrieved the record (ISO 8601).
scraped_at.title: Retrieved At

source_endpoint.description: Official open-data API endpoint the record was retrieved from.
source_endpoint.title: Source Endpoint

state.description: Two-letter US state code (WA, TX, or CA).
state.title: State

status.description: Current permit status as reported by the source portal.
status.title: Status

trade_category.description: Classified trade: solar, roofing, pool, adu, hvac, electrical, new_construction, or general.
trade_category.title: Trade Category

work_description.description: Scope-of-work description from the public permit record.
work_description.title: Work Description

zip_code.description: ZIP code of the permitted property, when provided by the source.
zip_code.title: ZIP Code
